query:
-- Link tags to Lysistrata
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Lysistrata'
  AND t.slug IN ('greek-comedy', 'classical-theatre', '2021')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );
